svg.title: Sub-agent isolation: one parent context and three independent child windows
svg.desc: A hand-drawn figure. A wide parent context panel holds an orchestrator agent carrying the high-level plan, the current goal, and a short summary of each child's output, and is noted as staying small because it never sees the children's working memory. Three arrows labelled task run down to three sub-agents — research, code, and eval — each with its own independent context window of roughly thirty, fifty, and ten thousand tokens, and each returning one short result back up. Every child writes to a shared filesystem drawn as a bar across the bottom, the inter-agent bus, holding plan.md, research notes, source, evaluation results, and AGENTS.md. A caption states that a research child reading ten large documents contributes one short answer to the parent, not the ten documents.
svg.text: The parent sees what it sent and what came back. Everything in between lives and dies inside the child.
High-level plan, the current goal, a short summary of each child's output.
Stays small: it never sees the children's working memory.
A research child that reads ten large documents contributes one short answer to the parent, not the ten documents.
